paper_metadata.title: Performance Comparison of QAOA Mixers for Ternary Portfolio Optimization

summary: The paper benchmarks five QAOA mixer designs (Standard, XY Ring, XY Parity Ring, XY Full, and QAMPA) for ternary portfolio optimization using real DAX30 market data on instances with N=5 (10 qubits) and N=8 (16 qubits). In noiseless simulations, XY Full and QAMPA achieve the best performance with approximation ratios exceeding ~0.99 at depth p≤7, but under depolarizing noise (η up to 0.01) the Standard mixer becomes superior beyond crossover thresholds around η≈0.003 (p=1) and η≈0.0005 (p≥5).

experiments.description: QAOA portfolio optimization on a ternary (long/flat/short) formulation comparing five mixers on N=5 assets with B=2, evaluated on statevector and QASM simulators.

algorithm.variant: QAOA with Standard Mixer, XY Ring Mixer, XY Parity Ring Mixer, XY Full Mixer, and QAMPA
algorithm.ansatz: alternating cost and mixer unitaries; XY-based variants use Dicke-state initial state
algorithm.convergence_criteria: classical optimization of expectation value; no explicit stopping criterion reported

hyperparameters.initial_parameter_search: grid search for p=1; layerwise parameter transfer for p>1

algorithm.parameter_initialization: For p=1, grid search over linear schedules; for p>1, parameters initialized from prior layer using four estimation methods and the best one selected

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Each ternary asset state z_i∈{1,0,-1} encoded with two qubits per asset: z_i = x_i^+ - x_i^-; total register size 2N qubits
problem_formulation.objective_function: min F(z)= q * sum_{i,j} σ_ij z_i z_j - (1-q) * sum_i μ_i z_i, with q=1/3
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Standard Mixer uses penalty term A(Σ_i z_i - B)^2; XY-based mixers enforce feasibility via hard constraint-preserving mixer and feasible initial state (Dicke state)
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Cost Hamiltonian derived from F^(A) with Pauli-Z mapping; includes pairwise ZZ terms and single-qubit Z terms

problem_instance.description: Ternary portfolio optimization on DAX30 stock data for 5 assets

dataset_specification.preprocessing: daily adjusted closing prices; daily simple returns; annualized expected returns and covariance matrix

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Historical prices from Yahoo Finance via yfinance; missing dates dropped; daily simple returns computed; expected returns annualized by geometric compounding over 252 trading days; covariance annualized by multiplying daily sample covariance by 252
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: 20 randomly generated portfolios based on DAX30 data; average approximation ratio and optimal solution probability over multiple output distributions; QASM uses finite-shot sampling

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Classical estimation of returns/covariance; grid search for initial parameters at p=1; layerwise parameter transfer for p>1
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Compute approximation ratio and optimal solution probability from measurement outcomes

speedup_claims.caveats: Paper reports comparative performance among QAOA mixers only; no classical optimization baseline or quantum speedup claim.

complexity_analysis.quantum_complexity: QAOA circuit depth scales with p; XY initial-state preparation depth O(n) and CNOT count O(k n) for Dicke-state preparation

advantage_assessment.resources_for_advantage: not specified; experiments limited to 10 qubits (N=5 assets)

experiments.description: Noise robustness study of QAOA mixers using a depolarizing noise channel applied after each gate, evaluated on a ternary portfolio instance with N=5 assets and B=2.

algorithm.variant: QAOA with Standard, XY Ring, XY Parity Ring, XY Full, and QAMPA mixers under depolarizing noise

key_results: XY-based mixers outperform the Standard mixer in noiseless settings but lose their advantage as noise increases.
Crossover noise thresholds observed: approx η≈0.003 for p=1 and η≈0.0005 for p≥5 in approximation ratio.
Performance degradation attributed to large gate counts and fragile Dicke-state initialization used by XY mixers.
